title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall - University of California on 1982-03-14
source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show featuring ripping Althea solos and a standout Saturday Night opener.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its great sound quality, delivering a clear and lively listening experience. Fans highlight the fire in the Althea solo work by Jerry and Bob, while the concert opened with an unexpected Bobby comment before jumping straight into a powerful Saturday Night. Aside from one reviewer’s gripe about the quirky start, the overall vibe is high‑energy and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong positive reviews (5 stars) praise sound quality and solo performances; one low rating notes a strange show start, leading to an overall mixed but leaning‑positive assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers specifically mention great sound and clarity with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opened abruptly with Bobby’s comment but immediately launched into a strong Saturday Night, maintaining momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Solo rips highlighted alongside Bob Weir.
band_member_comments.Bob: His solo work was noted as ripping together with Jerry.
